description: A hotel employs cleaners and receptionists. Cleaners earn $500 per week and receptionists earn $350 per week. The hotel requires a minimum of 100 workers of whom at least 20 must be receptionists. To keep the hotel clean and running smoothly, the number of receptionists should be at least a third of the number of cleaners. The hotel wants to keep the weekly wage bill below $30000. Formulate a LP to minimize the wage bill.
